If sentiment is consistently positive (≥0.67) in the last 3 days, reduce forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to avoid over-optimism.  
If sentiment is consistently negative (≤-0.33) in the last 3 days, increase forecast by 1.5–2.5% for early horizon (1–7 days) to offset pessimism.  
If sentiment shifts from positive to negative mid-horizon (day 8–15), reduce forecast by 2–4% for mid horizon to reflect sentiment reversal.  
If sentiment is mixed (±0.33) in the last 3 days, apply a 0.5–1.5% downward adjustment for late horizon (16–30 days) to dampen volatility.  
If sentiment is positive but forecasted price is >10% above recent high, reduce forecast by 2–3% for late horizon to prevent overcorrection.  
If sentiment is negative but forecasted price is <10% below recent low, increase forecast by 2–3% for late horizon to counteract underestimation.
